_comment: Brand identity config — single source of truth for the entire content engine. Fill all fields before first run. NOTHING in the engine is locked to any one company: colors, fonts, voice, layout (see 'format'), and content model (see 'content_model') all come from this file. See examples/luna-base/ (B2B, editorial-dark) and examples/restaurant/ (lifestyle, magazine-light) for two very different completed references.

_naming_rules._comment: Names that MUST NEVER appear (typos, retired names, competitors used incorrectly)

palette._comment: All hex values. Used by SVG figures, blog HTML, social cards.

_logo_orb_gradient._comment: Optional 2-stop gradient for brand logo orb. Set both stops to same color if no gradient.

_forbidden_colors._comment: Tailwind defaults or off-brand colors that MUST NOT appear. Validator rejects SVG/HTML containing these. Edit to match YOUR brand; the list below are generic Tailwind defaults.

format._comment: VISUAL + STRUCTURAL layout of every blog/social output. THIS is what makes the engine reusable across very different brands (B2B SaaS, restaurant, agency, law firm). Pick a preset, then override any field. See skills/brand-locked-blog-writing/references/format-presets.md for what each preset expands to. Nothing here is locked to any one company.
format._preset_note: If preset is anything other than 'custom', the skill resolves any field left null below from the preset. Set preset to 'custom' to control every field yourself. A non-null field here ALWAYS overrides the preset.

blog._hero_style_options: dark (dark band, light text) | light (light band, dark text) | image (full-bleed photo + overlaid title) | none (just an H1, no hero band)
blog._body_style_options: serif-editorial (serif body, thought-leadership) | sans-clean (sans body, product/SaaS) | magazine (large lede, mixed type, lifestyle)
blog._references_style_options: apa (APA 7th, academic) | simple (named links list) | none (no reference section)

cta._comment: Call-to-action block before the end. Uses company.url.

figures._enabled_options: true (generate SVG figures) | false (no figures; brand uses photos / none)
figures._type_options: svg-data (charts/diagrams from validated stats) | svg-decorative (mood / brand illustration, no data claims) | none
figures._count_by_slot_note: Object like {"A":3,"B":2,"C":1}. If null, resolved from content_model.slots / preset.
figures._footer_branding_options: orb-wordmark (gradient orb + domain + tagline) | wordmark (domain text only) | logo (logo image) | none

seo._comment: Generic SEO metadata. Safe to leave on for any brand.

images._comment: Where the THUMBNAIL and SOCIAL images come from. provider 'canva' = Claude writes a fresh clickbait prompt per piece and generates the image with the connected Canva tools at session time, then exports PNG. provider 'svg' = legacy inline SVG. NOTE: in-article blog figures are ALWAYS SVG regardless of this setting. Sizes verified June 2026.
images._provider_options: canva (requires the Canva connector) | svg (no external dependency)
images._style_note: Header may carry one short, bold clickbait HEADLINE (<=8 words, real wording). The ONLY brand wordmark allowed is exactly company.domain, small in a bottom-corner FOOTER - no tagline, no other text, no numbers unless real. Method: let Canva generate the visual + headline + wordmark, then AUDIT the editable text - fix the headline if mangled, make the wordmark read exactly company.domain, and DELETE any junk/gibberish/duplicate text - then commit. Never trust the generator spelling.

sizes._blog_thumbnail_note: Open Graph / link-preview standard (1.91:1). Keep headline + faces in the center 1080x600 safe zone.
sizes._linkedin_note: Square feed image for strong presence. Standard landscape/link alt: 1200x627.
sizes._facebook_note: Portrait 4:5 for max mobile real estate. Square alt: 1080x1080; landscape/link alt: 1200x630.

voice._comment: Account-based content strategy. Define ONE or MORE accounts your brand posts as. The default active account for blog writing is set by 'default_account'. The three accounts below are an EXAMPLE structure (B2B founder model); rename, remove, or add accounts to fit your brand.

personal._comment: Founder / individual voice — teach, do not hard-sell

company._comment: Official brand page — promotional CTAs OK

forbidden_phrases._comment: AI tells + generic LLM phrases. Hard reject by validator. Edit to taste.
generic_openers: I hope this finds you well

required_phrasings._comment: Brand-locked phrasings that ARE allowed even though they look like overclaims

forbidden_chars._comment: Em/en dashes and emoji rejected in published content. Set any to false to allow.

svg_figure._comment: Canonical viewBox for blog figures. Only used when format.blog.figures.enabled is true.

validated_stats._comment: Pre-approved stats with citations. When content_model.stat_rigor is 'strict', the validator hard-rejects any numeric claim NOT in this list. Each entry: claim, source, year, usage_note. Leave empty for lifestyle/brand content (set stat_rigor to 'off' or 'cited').

core_arguments._comment: 5-7 core thesis statements used as the spine of any content. Leave empty if your brand does not push a fixed thesis.

content_model._comment: WHAT KIND of content this brand publishes. The old 'foundational/comparison/news' slots and 'copilot/customer_proof/regulatory' angles were B2B-SaaS specific. Define your own here so the planner and social skills fit YOUR business.

slots._comment: Three daily publishing slots. Re-label intent + length for your brand. Examples below are neutral; replace freely.

pillars._comment: 3-5 core content domains for this brand. Planner distributes evenly across these. Empty => planner asks you.

feature_rotation_angles._comment: Recurring promo angles for the monthly feature post. B2B example: product_spotlight, customer_proof, differentiation, compliance. Restaurant example: new_menu, seasonal_event, chef_story, customer_review. Define YOUR angles. Empty => social skill skips feature rotation.

content_model._stat_rigor_options: strict (every number must be in validated_stats.entries; for data-heavy B2B) | cited (numbers allowed if cited inline with a real source) | off (no numeric-claim enforcement; for lifestyle/brand content)

seo._comment: SEO + Google quality settings used by the seo-optimization skill and the blog skill to make posts INDEXABLE, E-E-A-T compliant, and intent-matched. See skills/seo-optimization/references/google-seo-standards.md.
seo._quality_gate_options: strict (do not mark a post publish-ready until every E-E-A-T / indexability / human-voice / intent check passes) | advisory (flag issues, allow) | off

eeat._comment: Real identity signals for Experience/Expertise/Authoritativeness/Trust and the JSON-LD author/publisher. Fill with a REAL person/org; empty weakens E-E-A-T.
